name: Garuda
description: Garuda is a divine eagle-like bird in Hindu and Buddhist mythology, the mount (vahana) of Vishnu, king of birds, and eternal enemy of the nagas (serpents); it serves as the national symbol of Indonesia and Thailand.

aliases.name: Garuḍa
aliases.meaning: Possibly from verb gri (to speak); also associated with the sun

origin: Garuda is a central figure in Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism, giving him cultural presence across South Asia (India, Nepal), Southeast Asia (Indonesia, Thailand, Cambodia, Myanmar), and anywhere these religions have spread.
